user.title: Set up a meter
user.description: A camera looks at the counter of your meter and an AI Task entity reads its digits. Each reading is checked before it is used, so a misread digit never reaches your statistics or the Energy dashboard.

data_description.name: Used for the device and as the prefix of the entity IDs. Default: "Water meter", "Gas meter" or "Energy meter".

meter.title: {name}
meter.description: The camera can be any camera entity, for example an ESP32-CAM with ESPHome pointed at the counter.

data_description.unit_of_measurement: The unit of the number on the counter, with the decimal digits below. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.camera_entity: A camera pointed at the counter.
data_description.light_entity: Turned on for each frame and off right after, for meters in the dark.
data_description.ai_task_entity: An AI Task entity that can read images (for example Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI or Ollama with a vision model).
data_description.digits: How many digits the AI must read, leading zeros and decimal digits included, pointer dials not. 0 = do not check.
data_description.decimal_places: How many of the last digits are after the decimal point (often red). For example 3 for a counter of 8 digits in m³ with 3 red ones.
data_description.pointer_dials: Small round dials with a pointer after the decimal wheels (x0.0001, x0.001, ...), read for extra resolution. Each dial is one more decimal: for example 1 for a water meter in m³ with 3 red wheels and a x0.0001 dial. 0 = none.
data_description.initial_reading: The value shown now by the meter, including the decimals and dials. The readings are checked against it from the start.

error.too_many_decimals: The decimal digits must be fewer than the digits of the counter.
error.same_ai_task: Choose a different entity, or none.

data_description.camera_entity: A camera pointed at the counter.
data_description.light_entity: Turned on for each frame and off right after, for meters in the dark.
data_description.ai_task_entity: An AI Task entity that can read images (for example Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenAI or Ollama with a vision model).
data_description.fallback_ai_task_entity: Used when the main entity is unavailable or fails, for example a cloud model behind a local one.
data_description.digits: How many digits the AI must read, leading zeros and decimal digits included, pointer dials not. 0 = do not check.
data_description.decimal_places: How many of the last digits are after the decimal point (often red).
data_description.pointer_dials: Small round dials with a pointer after the decimal wheels (x0.0001, x0.001, ...), read for extra resolution. Each dial is one more decimal: for example 1 for a water meter in m³ with 3 red wheels and a x0.0001 dial. 0 = none.
data_description.read_interval: How often the meter is read.
data_description.light_warmup: Wait between turning the light on and taking the frame. Cameras with automatic exposure need 20-30 s, otherwise the frame is dark.
data_description.meter_notes: Anything peculiar about the counter, added to the AI instructions. For example: "ignore the last digit on a light blue background".
data_description.counter_region: Where the row of wheels is in the frame, in pixels: x, y, width, height (for example 192, 158, 296, 50). Only used to draw one box per wheel on the last frame, with the digit read; the AI always gets the whole frame. Find the numbers on the clean frame ("Frame sent to the AI") in any image editor.
data_description.dial_regions: Same for each pointer dial, separated by ; (for example 430, 288, 104, 104). One per dial, or empty.
data_description.notify_services: Notify actions that receive an alert when the meter cannot be read several times in a row.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also show the alert in the Home Assistant notifications.

error.too_many_decimals: The decimal digits must be fewer than the digits of the counter.
error.same_ai_task: Choose a different entity, or none.
error.invalid_region: Write four whole numbers: x, y, width, height (width and height above 0).
error.dial_regions_count: Give one position per pointer dial, or none.

no_ai.message: {name} has no AI Task entity: add one in the options.

negative_reading.message: A meter reading cannot be negative.

set_reading.name: Set reading
set_reading.description: Sets the reading of a meter by hand, for example after replacing the meter or to fix a wrong value. The next readings are checked against it.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value shown by the meter, in its unit.
